Tiqora at 3x2: the placement target is lowered to 50 so the cells spread across the bigger die. At the default packing (72) they stay clustered and detailed routing stalls (about 6,600 violations locally); at 50 global routing uses 52% of the tracks and detailed routing converges.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.

GRT_ADJUSTMENT - share of routing tracks global routing holds back (LibreLane default 0.3). At 0.3 Tiqora's 3x2 global route ends with 58 overflows and detailed routing grinds on its last 3 to 17 shorts for hours; at 0.15 global routing has 0 overflows and detailed routing finishes with 0 violations (local LibreLane 3.0.14, 2026-10-26: DRC 0, LVS 0, antenna 0). With the 1x buffers excluded, 0.15 left detailed routing stalled at 1 violation for 6 h on GitHub; 0.2 routes in about 30 minutes (2026-11-16, runs 43833386322 and 43890240177).

Tiqora at 3x2, timing repair (local LibreLane 3.0.14, 2026-10-26). CTS_SINK_CLUSTERING_SIZE 10 keeps each clock leaf within the fanout limit of 10 (83 fanout warnings -> 2). The post-global-route repair steps and the larger setup margins make the resizer work on near-critical paths: worst slow-corner setup slack -1.10 ns -> -0.75 ns, typical +6.45 ns. Routing stays clean (DRC 0, LVS 0, antenna 0).

CTS_DISTANCE_BETWEEN_BUFFERS - TritonCTS puts a clock buffer every 30 um along the H-tree. Without it the root buffer drove all 16 H-tree branches directly: fanout 16 over the limit of 10 plus a max-cap violation on clknet_0_clk at all 9 corners (run 44089517415). At 30 um: 0 fanout and cap violations, setup +1.335 ns, hold +0.147 ns (run 44111857909).
SYNTH_EXCLUDED_CELL_FILE - cells synthesis may not use. synth_exclude.cells is the PDK default minus its ban on drive-strength-1 cells (see the file).

Tiqora: with this list the flow's synthesis measures 48,763 um^2 instead of 59,797 um^2 and global placement at 2x2 uses 76.6% of the free core instead of 97.7% (LibreLane 3.0.14, measured locally 2026-10-25).

PNR_EXCLUDED_CELL_FILE - cells placement, CTS and the resizer may not use: the PDK's drc_exclude.cells plus the clkdlybuf4s* delay cells, which the resizer otherwise uses as ordinary buffers (see the file).
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.

Hold slack margins. After global routing the target is 0.25 ns: the inflated wire estimate (LAYERS_RC) makes data paths look slower than extraction finds, so a 0.1 ns target ended at +0.023 to +0.034 ns; 0.25 ends at +0.150 ns (run 44089517415).
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
TP_SKY130_DRIVE: src/tp_drive.sv becomes sky130 buf_4 cells on the register-file read selects and taps (chip build only; simulation, formal and FPGA see wires).

Save some time
Don't put clock buffers on the outputs

Input ports are not buffered by the resizer: with the 1x buffers banned, buffer_ports picked the smallest remaining buffer, dlygate4sd3_1 (a delay cell, about 1 ns at the slow corner), on every input. The rst_n path then missed slow-corner setup by 1.11 ns (Tiqora run 43890240177). Design repair still buffers these nets for slew and fanout.

Wire capacitance x2.2 over the tech-LEF values (res unchanged), for placement and routing estimates only; signoff STA reads the extracted SPEF. The tech LEF has no sidewall coupling, so the resizer sized drivers for about half the load extraction found: 3,045 slow-corner slew violations (run 44049238333). x1.8: 39, x2.2: 17, x2.6: 24 (runs 44044781307, 44055648178, 44069913686); with the tp_drive register-file drivers: 0 (run 44089517415). Post-route repair margins 30% (55% made that step run without end with this setting).
